goal: Довести MIMO runner contract до артефактов и repair tasks вместо молчаливых runtime errors.
objective: Verify and roll out the Agent Host contract where a MIMO run that exits successfully without text output becomes a structured blocked result with blocked_reason=mimo_empty_response, result.json, artifact-manifest.json and no retry loop. After canary, rerun or supersede P0_CONTROL_PLANE_HA_RUNTIME_CONTRACT_PARITY_2026_07_02 so runtime parity work can produce artifacts.

observed_gap.desired_behavior: runner_contract_blocked with blocked_reason=mimo_empty_response or required_artifacts_missing, plus repair task and stable result artifacts

implementation_requirements: Run focused tests or a deterministic harness for empty MIMO stdout.
Verify result.json and artifact-manifest.json are produced for empty MIMO output.
Verify fail payload uses error_type=runner_contract_blocked and retry=false for mimo_empty_response.
Prepare a canary rollout plan for Agent Host nodes before any service restart.
Do not mutate Telegram receiver, provider billing, secrets, or main branch.
After safe canary, rerun or create a superseding parity task for P0_CONTROL_PLANE_HA_RUNTIME_CONTRACT_PARITY_2026_07_02.
acceptance: Empty MIMO output is no longer reported as a raw runtime_error.
Empty MIMO output produces a blocked result with blocked_reason=mimo_empty_response.
Required artifacts and result manifest are present for the failed attempt.
Control Plane can create or receive an exact repair task for the blocked runner contract.
The parity task has a safe rerun path after canary.
No secrets, Telegram receiver state, provider billing, destructive changes, direct main push or force push occur.
